title: Kissed Smoky Venezuelan Lentils Paella
description: A vibrant and flavorful Venezuelan paella dish featuring green red lentils, smoky binchotan-charcoal, and a rich, pillowy texture. Perfect for adventurous eaters and special occasions.
instructions: Heat the binchotan charcoal in a small pan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and smoky.
Soak the green red lentils in water for at least 4 hours or overnight. Drain and rinse.
In a large paella pan or skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, white wine vinegar, and soaked green red lentils. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the heated binchotan charcoal and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
